notes: REF-BM-02: no remote metadata fetch; no title/description/favicon/preview collection. REF-BM-03: no auto metadata and no edit capability at all. REF-BM-04: no edit function; bookmarks can only be created and deleted. REF-BM-06: duplicate url is detected and blocked with an error naming the existing bookmark, but does not converge the user to editing the existing item (no edit path). REF-BM-07: list shows name and url only; no description, tags, or real favicon (just a letter avatar). REF-BM-09: bookmarks assign to a single collection (folder), not many-to-many tags; cannot assign 'one or more'. REF-BM-10: no tag entry/autocomplete. REF-BM-12: full-text search covers only name and url; no description/note fields exist. REF-BM-14: no #tag search syntax. REF-BM-15: no AND/OR/NOT/parentheses; plain substring match. REF-BM-16: no quoted-phrase exact match. REF-BM-17/18/19: no unread/read-later flag or view. REF-BM-20: multi-select bulk supports only delete and assign-to-collection; missing read/unread, archive, and tag add/remove. REF-BM-21: no 'apply to whole filtered collection' action; only manual selection. REF-BM-22: no sort option. REF-BM-23: no markdown notes. REF-BM-24/25: no local/PDF or Internet Archive snapshots. REF-BM-26/27/28: no archive concept (only permanent delete). REF-BM-29: no bundles/saved filters. REF-BM-30/31: no Netscape HTML import/export. REF-BM-32: no display settings (sort/items/font size).
